ValidationRule.description: who can close a Compensation Services Case
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Restrict_Compensation_Services_Closure ) , ISCHANGED( Status ) , ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed') , ( NSP_Category__c = 'Compensation Services' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have the required permissions to close this case. You can still reassign or cancel it if needed
